headers.comment: Security headers. These lived in web/public/_headers, which is Cloudflare Pages syntax that Firebase Hosting does not read — so they shipped nowhere while looking like a control. Verified against the hosting emulator: marketing pages get the enforced CSP; /app/** overrides Permissions-Policy and keeps its own Report-Only policy, which has never been exercised against the running app and must not be enforced until it has.
